metaTitle: Dossierly · your AI caseworker for life in Poland
metaDescription: A personal AI caseworker for newcomers with a temporary residence permit in Poland. It knows your case, explains official letters, counts deadlines the way Polish law does and helps you at the office counter.
ogDescription: Letters explained, deadlines counted the way Polish law does, and help at the office counter. Your own private agent for your residence case.
twitterDescription: Letters explained, deadlines counted the way Polish law does, and help at the office counter.
footerAi: You are using an AI system. Dossierly interprets and explains; it does not give legal or medical advice.
limitsMetaDesc: What Dossierly cannot do, and where its privacy and accuracy end.
limitsLead: The limits we know about, stated plainly.
limit1d: Dossierly does not submit applications, sign anything, or log in to MOS, inPOL or any government system for you. You stay in control of every official step.
limit2: Your case is processed by AI models
limit2d: To answer, Dossierly sends the relevant parts of your case to Claude by Anthropic. Spoken replies are generated by ElevenLabs. Their own terms apply to those inputs. Meta's models are used only for generated test letters, never for your content.
limit3d: Answers are grounded in your case and cite official sources where they can, but a model can still misread a letter or a rule. Check anything important against the original letter or the office.
limit4: Deadlines need the right delivery date
limit4d: We count from the delivery date we found or you gave us, applying KPA rules and Polish public holidays, and show every step. The date in your letter and the office's decision always win.
limit5d: Dossierly calling you about a new letter works only on approved demo accounts for now. In-app voice works for everyone.
limit6d: Dossierly is built for non-EU newcomers with a temporary residence permit in Poland, starting with the Mazowiecki office in Warsaw. Other permits and offices may be incomplete.
limit7d: Dossierly explains and organises. For advice, find a qualified lawyer (rejestradwokatow.pl) or a doctor.
countriesLead: Poland is supported today, in depth. Germany and France are next. We add a country only when its offices, letter types and deadline rules are covered from official sources.
polandMetaDesc: Offices, letter types with deadline rules, fees and the official sources Dossierly reads.

lt_wezwanie-braki-formalne_name: Summons to correct formal defects in the application
lt_wezwanie-braki-formalne_means: The office found something missing or wrong in the application itself, for example a photo or passport copy that does not meet the rules, and asks for it to be fixed by a date in the letter. If it is not fixed in time, the application is left without consideration (KPA art. 64 §2). This is a different summons from the fingerprint summons, whose consequence is discontinuation.
lt_wezwanie-braki-formalne_basis: Kodeks postępowania administracyjnego art. 64 § 2 (applied via the Act on Foreigners, art. 106e ust. 2)
lt_wezwanie-dokumenty_means: The office asks for documents that confirm the data in the application, for example proof of health insurance or an employer's documents. The statute sets a longer minimum than for formal defects and lets the office allow time to obtain the document.
lt_wezwanie-dokumenty_basis: Ustawa o cudzoziemcach art. 106f (from the start of MOS filing); before that art. 106 ust. 2a
lt_fingerprint-appointment_name: Summons to appear in person for fingerprints, signature specimen and passport
lt_fingerprint-appointment_means: The office sets a date and place where the applicant must come in person to give fingerprints and a signature specimen and to show the original passport. It is sent by e-Doręczenia or e-mail. If the applicant does not appear, the proceedings are discontinued (umorzenie, Ustawa o cudzoziemcach art. 106i), not left without consideration.
lt_fingerprint-appointment_basis: Ustawa o cudzoziemcach art. 106e ust. 1; re-taking prints art. 106g
lt_wezwanie-oplata_name: Summons to pay the stamp duty
lt_wezwanie-oplata_means: The office says the fee for the permit has not been paid or proven and asks for payment confirmation. It may arrive together with other summonses.
lt_wezwanie-oplata_basis: Ustawa o cudzoziemcach art. 106e ust. 2 names this summons but states no minimum term in the text read
lt_decyzja_means: The voivode's written decision on the application. The letter states whether the permit is granted or refused. A refusal can be appealed within a fixed period counted from delivery. The appeal goes through the voivode on paper or by e-Doręczenia, never through MOS.
lt_decyzja_basis: Kodeks postępowania administracyjnego art. 129 § 2 (appeal to the Szef UdSC through the voivode)
lt_karta-odbior_name: Notice of date and place to collect the residence card
lt_karta-odbior_means: After a permit is granted the office sends a message with the date and place to collect the residence card. It comes by e-mail, SMS or e-Doręczenia.
lt_karta-odbior_basis: No collection deadline stated in the sources read
lt_zawiadomienie-przedluzenie_name: Notice that the case will not be decided on time (new decision date)
lt_zawiadomienie-przedluzenie_means: The office tells the applicant it will not decide within the usual time, gives the reason and a new date, and states the right to file a complaint about delay (ponaglenie).
lt_zawiadomienie-przedluzenie_basis: Kodeks postępowania administracyjnego art. 36 § 1 (content of the notice); art. 35 § 3 (usual: one month, complicated cases two months)
office_wsc-marszalkowska: ul. Marszałkowska 3/5, 00-624 Warszawa. Customer service Mon 10:00-17:30, Tue-Fri 8:00-15:00. Sobota Informacyjna 24.10.2026 was held here 8:00-15:00.
office_wsc-jerozolimskie: Al. Jerozolimskie 28, 00-624 Warszawa (as printed on the contact page). Same hours: Mon 10:00-17:30, Tue-Fri 8:00-15:00.
office_wsc-bankowy: pl. Bankowy 3/5, 00-950 Warszawa, entrance G. Card issue/exchange submissions: Punkt Obsługi Klienta, pl. Bankowy 3/5, entrance F (from Al. Solidarności), per the 19.02.2026 komunikat.
office_wsc-krucza: ul. Krucza 5/11, 00-548 Warszawa, entrance E. Same hours. FAQ: the office assigns the date and one of the 4 locations by e-mail.
office_wsc-contact-center: (22) 695 67 73, Mon-Fri 8:00-15:00. Consultants do not say the type of decision issued. Delegatury (branch offices) of the voivodeship were not verified.
fee_stamp-pobyt-czasowy-i-praca: Stamp duty for a combined temporary residence and work permit (zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy i pracę)
fee_stamp-pobyt-czasowy-pozostale: Stamp duty for other temporary residence permits (pozostałe przypadki, including the CUKR card) - not the work permit
fee_karta-pobytu: Issue or exchange of the residence card (adults and children for the CUKR card)
fee_karta-pobytu-maloletni: Card issue/exchange for minors under 16, upper-secondary pupils and students
fee_karta-pobytu-wymiana-utrata: Card exchange after culpable loss or destruction (300 zł for a repeat)
fee_stamp-pobyt-staly: Stamp duty for a permanent residence permit (also EU long-term resident)
fee_stamp-zmiana-pobyt-praca: Change of a residence and work permit
fee_zaswiadczenie: Issuing a certificate (wydanie zaświadczenia), a fee item on the WSC fees page
fee_duplikat-decyzji: Duplicate of a decision, per started page
fee_mos-fee-range: UdSC summary: stamp duty ranges from 340 to 640 zł depending on permit type, plus 100 zł for the card; no fee for using MOS
uv1_claim: https://mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl announcements page and any portal-level komunikaty
uv1_tried: DNS for mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl did not resolve from the research machine; URL confirmed only through UdSC and a gov.pl redirect. Portal announcements not read.
uv2_claim: The Monitor Polski komunikat that fixes the date from which art. 106b-106i of the Act on Foreigners apply
uv2_tried: Read Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1794 art. 17 and 19, which defer to such a komunikat; searched the ELI API (no match). UdSC and WSC state 27 April 2026.
uv3_claim: A deadline for collecting the residence card, and a Mazowieckie-specific 'zawiadomienie o przedłużeniu terminu' template
uv3_tried: Read the WSC procedure, komunikaty and FAQ pages; found only KPA art. 35-36 (general) and the statement that the office sets the pickup appointment.
uv4_claim: Whether the 19.10.2026 komunikat has a publication date other than the listing date
uv4_tried: The item page shows no date; the /komunikaty listing shows 19.10.2026.
uv5_claim: Official list of documents a clinic requires from a foreigner to register (POZ)
uv5_tried: pacjent.gov.pl pages describe the declaration but list no identity documents; the Zielona Linia insurance-proof page is dated 2020. See doctor-registration skill.
uv6_claim: Which documents a bank requires of a foreigner for an ordinary current account
uv6_tried: Only the basic payment account (Ustawa o usługach płatniczych art. 59ic) and a 2019 Rzecznik Finansowy analysis found; individual bank requirements are not official sources.
uv7_claim: Task claim '340 zł = application for temporary residence, 440 zł = combined, 100 zł = card' as three separate flat fees
uv7_tried: Confirmed on /wskazowki/oplaty with one nuance: 340 zł is 'pozostałe przypadki' of temporary residence (not the work permit), 440 zł is the combined permit, 100 zł is the card (50 zł for minors/students except under CUKR).
